mapper.select:
SELECT a.id as assignment_id, a.name as assignment_name, a.rubric_meta_info, a.rubrics_info,
asub.session_id, asub.subject_type, asub.subject_id,
-- Student/Group info CASE WHEN asub.subject_type = 'student' THEN su.user_name WHEN asub.subject_type = 'group' THEN sg.group_name ELSE 'Unknown' END as entity_name,
CASE WHEN asub.subject_type = 'group' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_student_group sgm WHERE sgm.group_id = asub.subject_id ) ELSE NULL END as group_member_count
FROM assignment a JOIN assessment_submission asub ON a.id = asub.assignment_id LEFT JOIN sys_student st ON asub.subject_type = 'student' AND asub.subject_id = st.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON st.user_id = su.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_group sg ON asub.subject_type = 'group' AND asub.subject_id = sg.group_id
WHERE a.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND a.id = #{assignmentId} AND asub.id = #{submissionId} LIMIT 1

SELECT asub.id as submission_id, asub.examiner_id, asub.status as assessment_status, asub.submitted_at, asub.total_score, asub.overall_feedback, asub.admin_note as notes, asub.rubric_meta_snapshot, asub.rubrics_info_snapshot, asub.scores_json,
-- Examiner info u.user_name as examiner_name
FROM assessment_submission asub JOIN sys_user u ON asub.examiner_id = u.user_id
WHERE asub.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND asub.session_id = #{sessionId} AND asub.subject_type = #{subjectType} AND asub.subject_id = #{subjectId}
ORDER BY asub.examiner_id

SELECT asub.id as submission_id, asub.examiner_id, asub.status as assessment_status, asub.submitted_at, asub.total_score, asub.overall_feedback, asub.admin_note as notes, asub.rubric_meta_snapshot, asub.rubrics_info_snapshot, asub.scores_json,
-- Examiner info u.user_name as examiner_name
FROM assessment_submission asub JOIN sys_user u ON asub.examiner_id = u.user_id
WHERE asub.id = #{submissionId} AND asub.examiner_id = #{examinerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE assignment SET results_released = CASE WHEN #{releaseStatus} = 'RELEASED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, results_released_at = CASE WHEN #{releaseStatus} = 'RELEASED' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{assignmentId}

UPDATE assessment_submission SET updated_at = NOW() WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND ( -- For individual assessments, update the specific student's submissions (subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND #{subjectType} = 'INDIVIDUAL') OR -- For group assessments, update all submissions for group members (subject_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND #{subjectType} = 'GROUP' AND subject_id IN ( SELECT sg.user_id FROM sys_student_group sg WHERE sg.group_id = #{subjectId} )) OR -- Also update the group-level submission if it exists (subject_type = 'GROUP' AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND #{subjectType} = 'GROUP') ) -- Note: finalScore, reason, userId parameters are ignored until database columns are added
